context:
Follows the initial cloud runs established in first-live-cloud-benchmark-run-and-publish. BigQuery adapter hotfixes for table casing, rate-limiting throttling (1s inter-chunk sleep), and query execution telemetry propagation are in place. TPC-DS at SF 10.0 involves 99 complex queries; monitor warehouse timeouts and API burst limits during execution.

Delivered 2026-10-04. All 18 bundles are published and live on benchbox.dev:
- TPC-DI SF 0.1 and 1 on BigQuery and Snowflake in #2602.
- TPC-DI SF 10 and all Databricks TPC-DI, plus all nine TPC-DS bundles, in #2615.
- published-results mirror #2620; site promotion run 37213072128.
Every query succeeded. TPC-DI row counts agree across the three platforms. Snowflake and Databricks were rerun with validated cache-off receipts.

One deviation from the zero-errors criterion, by owner decision: five TPC-DS bundles keep unofficial classifications and are admitted through the lenient lane. They are SF 0.1 on all three platforms (unofficial_subscale) and BigQuery SF 1 and SF 10 (unofficial_nonstandard). Snowflake SF 0.1 and SF 10 carry owner-approved scale-invariant overrides. See results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md "Cloud TPC-DS bundles (2026-10-04)" and "TPC-DI at SF 10 and on Databricks (2026-10-04)". Follow-up: local-tpcdi-bundles-regenerate-current-generator.
description:
Expand live cloud benchmark execution beyond TPC-H to the remaining standard TPC analytical benchmarks: TPC-DS (99 complex decision support queries) and TPC-DI (data integration/ETL pipeline).

Execute across all three cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake) at the established scale factors:
- Scale factors: 0.1, 1.0, and 10.0
- Target platforms:
  * Google BigQuery (Serverless)
  * Databricks SQL (Serverless 2X-Small)
  * Snowflake (X-Small warehouse)
- Expected runs: 18 total (9 TPC-DS runs, 9 TPC-DI runs).
- Verification: Validate each generated bundle with benchbox.validation.bundle.validate_bundles and scripts/validate_submission.py. Ensure query success, power metrics, scan/billing metrics (BigQuery), and platform metadata are fully populated.
